name: Masaoka Shiki
credit: Portrait of Masaoka Shiki (photograph) · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons). Poems: Aozora Bunko, from Shiki zenshu vol. 1 (Kodansha, 1975), manuscript Kanzan rakuboku (National Diet Library)
bio: 正岡子規 (Masaoka Shiki, 1867–1902) was born in Matsuyama on the island of Shikoku and died in Tokyo at thirty-four, after years of spinal tuberculosis that kept him largely bedridden. He took the pen-name Shiki, the hototogisu or cuckoo, a bird said to cough blood as it sings, after his first haemorrhage in 1889.

Working as a journalist, he set out to renew haiku and tanka on the principle of shasei, a sketch from life, and he abandoned the older word-play and conventional images in favour of direct observation. The Aozora Bunko text of his Kanzan rakuboku, volume one, is a manuscript record of his early hokku arranged by season; the selection here is drawn from its final year, 1892, and includes none of the later volumes.

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 1: 不盡赤し (Fuji akashi)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 不盡赤し筑波を見れは初日の出

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 2: 小松曳 (Komatsu-biki)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 小松曳袴の泥も畫にかゝん

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 3: 遣羽子を (Yariba o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 遣羽子をつき／＼よける車哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 4: うつかりと (Ukkari to)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: うつかりと元日の朝の長寢哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 涅槃會や蚯蚓ちきれし鍬の先

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 6: 鳴さして (Nakisashite)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鳴さして鶯むせふ餘寒哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 7: 涅槃會や (Nehan-e ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 涅槃會や何見て歸る子供達

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 8: 人の世の (Hito no yo no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 人の世の工夫ではなし削り掛

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 9: 死はいやぞ (Shi wa iya zo)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 死はいやぞ其きさらぎの二日灸

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 10: 此頃の (Kono koro no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 此頃の夜の朧さや白き花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 11: 涅槃像 (Nehan-zō)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 涅槃像寫眞なき世こそたふとけれ

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 12: 氣の輕き (Ki no karuki)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 氣の輕き拍子也けり茶摘歌

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 13: 青柳に (Aoyagi ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 青柳にふりけされけり春の雪

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 14: 春雨に (Harusame ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 春雨に白木よごるゝ宮ゐかな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 15: 江戸人は (Edobito wa)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 江戸人は上野をさして春の山

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 16: 海人か家の (Ama ga ie no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 海人か家の若水猶も汐はゆし

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 17: 乕といふ (Tora to iu)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 乕といふ仇名の猫ぞ戀の邪魔

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 18: 飼猫や (Kaineko ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 19: 白魚や (Shirauo ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 白魚やそめ物洗ふすみた川

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 20: 鶯や (Uguisu ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鶯やみあかしのこる杉の杜

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 21: 迷ひ行く (Mayoi yuku)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 迷ひ行く胡蝶哀れや小松原

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 22: 竹藪や (Takeyabu ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 竹藪や鶯の鳴く窓二つ

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 23: すう／＼と (Sūsū to)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: すう／＼と鳥雲に入てしまひけり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 24: 門しめに (Kadoshime ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 門しめに出て聞て居る蛙かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 25: 燕の (Tsubame no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 燕の何聞くふりぞ電信機

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 26: 子に鳴いて (Ko ni naite)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 子に鳴いて見せるか雉の高調子

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 殿方に手をひかれたる花見哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 30: 大かたの (Ōkata no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 大かたの枯木の中や初櫻

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 31: 小娘の (Komusume no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 小娘のからかささすやちる櫻

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 一鞭に其數知れず落椿

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 荒れにけり茅針まじりの市の坪

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 梅ちらり／＼と松の木の間哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 西山に櫻一木のあるじ哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 45: 馬繋ぐ (Uma tsunagu)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 馬繋ぐ薄紅梅の戸口かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 46: 松原へ (Matsubara e)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 松原へ雪投げつけんふし詣

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 47: 初産の (Uizan no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 初産の髮みだしたる暑さ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 48: 傘張は (Kasabari wa)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 傘張は傘の陰なる晝寐かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 49: 留守の家に (Rusu no ie ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 留守の家にひとり燃たる蚊遣哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 50: きぬ／＼の (Kinuginu no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 烏帽子着て加茂の宮守涼みけり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 52: どこ見ても (Doko mite mo)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 53: 涼しさや (Suzushisa ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 涼しさや音に立ちよる水車

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 54: 梅干の (Umeboshi no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 梅干の雫もよわるあつさ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 55: 土用干 (Doyōboshi)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 土用干うその鎧もならびけり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 56: 鎌倉は (Kamakura wa)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鎌倉は何とうたふか田植哥

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 57: 松陰に (Matsukage ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 松陰に蚤とる僧のすゞみ哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 短夜は柳に足らぬつゝみ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 59: 面白う (Omoshirō)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 面白う紙帳をめぐる蚊遣哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 60: 御祓して (Misogi shite)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 御祓してはじめて夏のをしき哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 時鳥鳴くやどこぞに晝の月

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 92: いしぶみの (Ishibumi no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 足六つ不足もなしに蝉の殼

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 行燈の丁子よあすは初松魚

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 澁鮎の岩關落す嵐かな

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 宮嶋に汐やふむらん月の鹿

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 218: 鰯ひく (Iwashi hiku)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鰯ひく數に加はるわらは哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 219: 一ツ家の (Hitotsuya no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 一ツ家の家根に蓼咲く山路かな

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 何もかもかれて墓場の鷄頭花

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 葛の葉をふみ返したる別哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 秋風に枝も葉もなし曼珠沙花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 223: 竹椽を (Take-en o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 竹椽を團栗はしる嵐哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 224: どん栗や (Donguri ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: どん栗や一ツころがる納屋の隅

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 225: 行く秋や (Yuku aki ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 行く秋や刀豆一ツあらはるゝ

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 226: 唐辛子 (Tōgarashi)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 唐辛子辛きが上の赤さかな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 227: 行秋や (Yuku aki ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 行秋やつられてさがる唐辛子

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 228: 煙にも (Kemuri ni mo)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 煙にも更にすゝけず唐からし

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 229: 蕃椒 (Banshō)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 蕃椒心ありける浮世かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 230: 世の中を (Yo no naka o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 世の中を赤うばかすや唐辛子

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 231: 蘇東坡の (Sotōba no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 蘇東坡の笠やつくらん竹の春

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 232: 笠一ツ (Kasa hitotsu)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 笠一ツ動いて行くや木賊刈

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 233: 送火の (Okuribi no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 送火の灰の上なり桐一葉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 234: 蕣の (Asagao no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 蕣の地をはひわたる明家哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 235: 乞食の (Kojiki no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 乞食のぬる野は花と成にけり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 236: 百姓の (Hyakushō no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 百姓の秋はうつくし葉鷄頭

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 237: 一谷は (Ichinotani wa)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 一谷は雲すみつかぬ薄かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 238: 風一筋 (Kaze hitosuji)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 風一筋川一筋の薄かな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 239: 紅葉する (Momiji suru)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 紅葉する木立もなしに山深し

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 240: 草刈の (Kusakari no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 草刈の刈りそろへけり花薄

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 241: 狩りくらす (Karikurasu)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 狩りくらす靱の底の紅葉哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 242: 御陵と (Misasagi to)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 御陵としらで咲けり萩の花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 243: 松茸や (Matsutake ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 松茸や京は牛煮る相手にも

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 244: 古寺や (Furudera ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 古寺や木魚うつ／＼萩のちる

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 245: 秋の山 (Aki no yama)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 秋の山瀧を殘して紅葉哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 246: をさな子の (Osanago no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: をさな子の鬼灯盛るや竹の籠

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 247: うき人に (Ukibito ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: うき人にすねて見せけり女郎花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 248: 朝霧の (Asagiri no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 朝霧の杉にかたよるもみち哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 249: 牛の子を (Ushi no ko o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 牛の子を追ひ／＼はいるもみち哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 250: 藪蔭に (Yabukage ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 藪蔭に夕日の足らぬもみち哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 251: 眞黒に (Makkuro ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 眞黒に釣鐘暮れるもみち哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 火ともせはずんぶり暮るゝ紅葉哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 253: 辨當を (Bentō o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 辨當を鹿にやつたるもみち哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 254: 井戸堀や (Idohori ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 井戸堀や砂かぶせたる蓼の花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 255: わりなしや (Warinashi ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: わりなしや小松をのぼる蔦紅葉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 256: 北風や (Kitakaze ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 北風や芋屋の烟なびきあへず

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 257: 初雪を (Hatsuyuki o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 初雪をふるへばみのゝ雫かな

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 雪の日の隅田は青し都鳥

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 白雪におされて月のぼやけ哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 万山の木のはの音や寒の月

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 261: 新聞で (Shinbun de)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 新聞で見るや故郷の初しくれ

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 262: 鰒汁や (Fukujiru ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鰒汁や髑髏をかざる醫者の家

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 263: ものくはで (Mono kuwade)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: ものくはでかうもやせたか鉢敲

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 264: 面白う (Omoshirō)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 面白うたゝかば泣かん鉢叩

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 266: 小春日や (Koharibi ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 小春日や又この背戸も爺と婆

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 267: 初冬に (Hatsufuyu ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 初冬に何の句もなき一日かな

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 馬糞のいきり立たる寒さ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 269: 年の尾や (Toshi no o ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 年の尾や又くりかへすさかさ川

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 270: きぬ／＼に (Kinuginu ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: きぬ／＼にものいひ殘す寒哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 羽子板のうらに春來る師走哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 272: 炭竈に (Sumigama ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 炭竈に雀のならぶぬくみかな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 273: 君味噌くれ (Kimi miso kure)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 君味噌くれ我豆やらん冬こもり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 274: 節分や (Setsubun ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 節分や親子の年の近うなる

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 275: 寒聲や (Kangoe ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 寒聲や誰れ石投げる石手川

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 276: にくらしき (Nikurashiki)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: にくらしき客に豆うつねらひ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 277: 臘八の (Rōhatsu no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 臘八のあとにかしましくりすます

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 278: 榾の火に (Hodo no hi ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 榾の火に石版摺のすゝけかな

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 世の中を紙衣一つの輕さかな

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 280: 淨林の (Jōrin no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 淨林の釜にむかしを時雨けり

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 281: 鮎死て (Ayu shinite)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鮎死て瀬の細りけり冬の川

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 282: 色里や (Irozato ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 色里や時雨きかぬも三年ごし

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: しくるゝや弘法死して一千年

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 284: 灯の青う (Hi no aō)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 灯の青うすいて奧あり藪の雪

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 興居嶋へ魚舟いそぐ吹雪哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 286: 子をかばふ (Ko o kabau)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 子をかばふ鶴たちまどふ吹雪哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 287: 關守の (Sekimori no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 關守の雪に火を燒く鈴鹿哉

poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 馬糞のぬくもりにさく冬牡丹

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 289: はげそめて (Hagesomete)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: はげそめてやゝ寒げ也冬紅葉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 290: 麥蒔た (Mugimaita)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 麥蒔た顏つきもせす二百人

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 291: 小石にも (Koishi ni mo)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 小石にも魚にもならず海鼠哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 292: 海原に (Unabara ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 海原に星のふる夜やむら千鳥

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 293: 文覺を (Mongaku o)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 文覺をとりまいて鳴く千鳥哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 294: 冬椿 (Fuyutsubaki)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 冬椿猪首に咲くぞ面白き

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 295: 冬枯の (Fuyugare no)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 冬枯の野に學校のふらふ哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 296: 鷺谷に (Sagitani ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 鷺谷に一本淋し枯尾花

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 297: ほろ／＼と (Horohoro to)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: ほろ／＼と朝霜もゆる落葉哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 298: わろひれす (Warohiresu)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: わろひれす鷹のすわりし嵐哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 299: 居風呂に (Suefuro ni)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 居風呂に紅葉はねこむ筧哉

poems.title: 寒山落木 巻一 300: 石壇や (Ishidan ya)
poems.author: Masaoka Shiki
poems.text: 石壇や一つ／＼に散もみち
